source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 5. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.
topic: Step by step, the way of the Prophet ﷺ

learn.en: Intend in your heart, then say “Bismillāh”.
learn.title: Steps 1–2

learn.en: Wash your hands to the wrists 3 times, between the fingers too. Rinse your mouth 3 times. Sniff water into your nose and blow it out 3 times.
learn.title: Steps 3–5

learn.en: Wash your face 3 times, from the hairline to the chin and from ear to ear. Wash your right arm up to and including the elbow 3 times, then the left.
learn.title: Steps 6–7

learn.en: Wipe your head with wet hands, front to back and back again. Wipe your ears inside and out.
learn.title: Steps 8–9

learn.en: Wash your right foot up to and including the ankle 3 times, then the left. Don't forget between the toes and the heels! The Prophet ﷺ warned about dry heels. (Bukhari 60)
learn.title: Step 10: feet and heels

learn.en: After wudu, say the shahādah. The Prophet ﷺ said the eight gates of Paradise open for the one who makes wudu well and says it. (Muslim 234)
learn.title: After wudu
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh

words.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
words.en: After wudu: I bear witness there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger
words.tr: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh

order.en: Put the parts of wudu in order

quiz.en: How far do we wash the arms?
opts: Up to and including the elbows

quiz.en: Which part do we wipe, not wash?
True or false? Washing each part once is enough, and three times is the Sunnah.
True or false? It's fine to leave the heels dry.
True or false? We start with the right side.

move.en: Act out wudu from hands to feet — don't forget your heels!

think.q: Sara was late. She forgot Bismillah, the water stopped at her wrists, and her heels stayed dry. What mistakes can you find?
think.a: She forgot Bismillah, she didn't wash up to the elbows, and her heels were dry. The elbows and heels must be washed!

parents.summary: Wudu: intention, Bismillah, hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to the elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to the ankles — then the shahādah.
parents.tip: Watch your child make wudu once and check elbows and heels together.
